claim_boundary: held-out support-path reproducibility and prefix-to-next-support prediction; not causality and not execution substitution
primary_claim: a held-out prefix predicts subsequent operator-specific support better than marginal-frequency, layer-frequency, unordered-set, permutation, operator-swap and strongest-single-event controls at matched candidate budget

transition_identity.source_rule: semantic source only; never an execution-derived carrier or residual state
transition_identity.answer_rule: target declared before execution; never the model's observed answer

required: semantic transition rows and transition identities
discovery and held-out assignments grouped by transition identity
model, container, realization and operation-plan identities
observation level, source top-k, byte budget and refusal policy
population_binding.mutation_rule: changing a bound population field after assessment starts creates a new experiment identity

join_contract.attention_authority: HEAD-OBS-1 child reconstruction from the canonical attention write
join_contract.ffn_authority: production-effective GW-0B-style child reconstruction from the canonical FFN write

path_extraction.normalization: discovery-only empirical absolute-contribution distribution per operator and normalized-depth quartile
path_extraction.sparse_operator_rule: fewer than 20 discovery observations refuses that operator
path_extraction.site_admission: current absolute contribution is at least the locked discovery quantile; evaluated independently at the current site
path_extraction.prefix_causality: no later event, whole-path total, recurrence statistic or outcome may affect admission of an earlier event
path_extraction.tie_break: canonical ascending physical address within an admitted site
path_extraction.zero_mass_rule: may remain for parent accounting with empty physical support; cannot count as recovered next event
path_extraction.truncation_rule: retain the child-support cap, mark mass_truncated and report achieved child mass

sensitivity.verdict_rule: reported only; cannot replace the primary operating point

alignment.exact_within_family: equal operator sequence and exact site sequence

global_alignment.mismatch_tie_break: prefer two gaps so different operators never align

split_discipline.same_transition_recurrence: different execution identities and, for the primary invariance contrast, different prompt-family or prompt identities

controls: same transition identity with different execution identity
same relation/task stratum with different transition identity

prediction.primary_score: true next-event absolute contribution-mass retention; zero unless operator and eligible site are correct
prediction.assessment_exclusion: predictor cannot retrieve another assessment realization of the same transition identity

progression_gate.selection: first candidate_k point satisfying the full conjunction

successors.causality: ATTR-1C or a separately frozen causal-path rung
successors.executability: a separately frozen skip/route/prefetch/substitute rung with correctness, calibration and saved-work gates

amendment_rule: after assessment begins, record corrections and deviations in a separate adjudication artifact; do not silently rewrite this contract
